agentSpecialAbilities.name: Authenticate
agentSpecialAbilities.description: Validates any and all marks placed on a node.

effects.result: Detects whether users with falsified marks are present in the node (but not which users).
All falsified marks are rejected and purged from the node. User is denied access to node's prompts for remainder of session or until agent is crashed.

agentSpecialAbilities.name: Corrupt and Burn
agentSpecialAbilities.description: More sophisticated version of Corruption. Degrades active utility by 1 point per success. If utility reduced to zero, it Burns the utility slot (rendered useless until repaired).
agentSpecialAbilities.notes: Burned slots require Computer (B/R) skill and 100% cost to repair.

agentSpecialAbilities.name: Corruption
agentSpecialAbilities.description: Degrades an active utility of agent's choice by 1 point for every success scored. Can degrade utilities not normally categorized as degradable.

effects.result: No longer available until restored via Boot Utility prompt or reloaded from SCC copy.

agentSpecialAbilities.name: Erosion
agentSpecialAbilities.description: Attempts to permanently degrade a specific attribute associated with a Matrix enabled device.

effects.result: Targeted attribute degraded by 1 point per success (no effect on utility slots or other attributes for active session).
Icon crashes. Targeted attribute permanently reduced by 1 point.

agentSpecialAbilities.name: Guardian
agentSpecialAbilities.target: All datafiles and datastreams in host
agentSpecialAbilities.description: Encrypts all datafiles and datastreams currently active within the host up to agent's rating.
agentSpecialAbilities.duration: Persists until agent is dismissed or icon is crashed in cybercombat.

effects.result: Thwarts any use of Crack Protections prompt while active.

agentSpecialAbilities.name: Infiltration
agentSpecialAbilities.test: Hacking vs Sys/Sec (using Access Node prompt)
agentSpecialAbilities.description: Agent installs itself into target's Memory, toggles visibility to Hidden, and goes dormant for hours equal to its rating.
constraints: If agent's rating or Mp size exceed host's Memory capacity, agent can reduce rating to complete action; otherwise fails.

variants.name: Infiltration: Memory Lock
variants.description: When agent crashes, it unpacks into self-replicating tokens. Infected icon's Memory (including data stores and add-on Memory) is pressed to capacity and rendered inoperable.
variants.effect: User cannot move, upload, download, or manipulate any Memory resource until device is purged by Dewormer Protocol.

variants.name: Infiltration: Report
variants.description: When agent crashes, it uses Send Transmission to submit incriminating information to Grid Overwatch Division or associated DemiGOD.
variants.effect: Increases user's Overwatch score by agent's rating on next Logon. Information received is same as successful Signal Trace.

agentSpecialAbilities.notes: If Search and Rendered while dormant, agent can be revealed and engaged in cybercombat.

agentSpecialAbilities.name: Instance
agentSpecialAbilities.description: Target icon is jumped into an 'instance' (superficially identical copy) of the current node.

effects.result: From target's perspective, nothing has changed.
Target cannot successfully utilize Jump Grid / Host or Access Node prompts.
Attempts to utilize node's specialized prompts automatically fail.
Attempting to exit node via pathways returns target to where they started.

agentSpecialAbilities.duration: Persists until target utilizes Terminate Session prompt or crashes agent in cybercombat.

agentSpecialAbilities.name: Respawn
agentSpecialAbilities.trigger: Agent's icon is crashed in cybercombat
agentSpecialAbilities.description: Agent reconstitutes itself into a lesser configuration.

effects.result: Agent splits and respawns into two identical agents.
Each new agent has rating equal to half of original (rounded down).
New agents respawn and roll into initiative at top of next Combat Phase (-10 for each phase already elapsed).

agentSpecialAbilities.limitation: Ability is lost once agent is reduced to rating of 1.
